metadata.repo_type_justification: CFML application source code with web application runtime on ColdFusion/IIS serving HTTP requests, backed by SQL Server 2005. Single deployable unit with session management and database access.
metadata.archetype_justification: SQL Server database with document CRUD operations (search, upload, download), file storage on local disk, and user session management. Write operations and persistent state indicate stateful-crud.

findings.title: All compute on raw EC2 with EOL operating system
findings.description: All compute runs on a single raw Windows EC2 instance running IIS 7 with Adobe ColdFusion 8. Windows Server 2008 (EOL). No managed container orchestration or serverless.
findings.gap: No managed compute services adopted. Single EC2 instance with EOL operating system and application runtime.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite application in a modern language and deploy on ECS Fargate or Lambda. Eliminate the self-managed EC2 instance running EOL software.

findings.title: SQL Server 2005 self-managed on single EC2 instance
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 running self-managed on the same Windows EC2 instance. No managed database services. Connection via ColdFusion datasource configured in CF Administrator.
findings.gap: Database is entirely self-managed with no automated failover, no managed backups, no patching. EOL engine.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server or Aurora PostgreSQL. Use AWS DMS for data migration.

findings.title: No workflow orchestration for document lifecycle
findings.description: No workflow orchestration service in use. Document search and download flows are hardcoded directly in .cfm templates with no structured workflow management.
findings.gap: All workflow logic hardcoded in application code with no dedicated orchestration service.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement document lifecycle workflows using AWS Step Functions for multi-step operations.

findings.title: No messaging or streaming infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All operations are synchronous HTTP. For a stateful-crud service, no async messaging for cross-service state changes or notifications.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes could benefit from decoupled notification.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, adopt Amazon SQS or EventBridge for document lifecycle events.

findings.title: No network security configuration
findings.description: No network security configuration found. Application runs HTTP only on internal network with no HTTPS, no VPC configuration, no security groups, no network segmentation.
findings.gap: No evidence of VPC, private subnets, security groups, or network segmentation. HTTP-only communication.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a properly configured VPC with private subnets, security groups, and HTTPS enforcement via ALB with TLS termination.

findings.title: No API Gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or any managed entry point. ColdFusion application served directly by IIS 7 on EC2.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Place an ALB or API Gateway in front of the service for throttling, authentication, and TLS termination.

findings.title: No auto-scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Single EC2 instance with static capacity. Reboot equals downtime.
findings.gap: No auto-scaling — all capacity statically provisioned on a single instance.
findings.recommendation: When redeploying on managed compute, configure auto-scaling with appropriate policies.

findings.title: No backup or recovery configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration. README states 'no backups offsite' and 'disk loss = data loss'. No SQL Server backup, no AWS Backup plans.
findings.gap: No automated backups for database or file storage. Complete data loss on disk failure.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS (automatic backups with PITR) and S3 (versioning + lifecycle policies).

findings.title: No infrastructure as code
findings.description: No IaC exists. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Helm, or any other IaC tool. All infrastructure created manually.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage. All infrastructure created manually (ClickOps).
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in code using AWS CDK or Terraform.

findings.title: No CI/CD automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment is manual file copy over network share to wwwroot. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CodePipeline.
findings.gap: All deployments are manual file copies. No automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD using AWS CodePipeline + CodeBuild or GitHub Actions with automated testing and deployment stages.

findings.title: ColdFusion 8 — EOL language with no cloud-native tooling
findings.description: CFML (ColdFusion Markup Language) running on Adobe ColdFusion 8. EOL with multiple critical CVEs, no AWS SDK, no cloud-native framework ecosystem.
findings.gap: Language with no AWS SDK and no cloud-native tooling. Requires migration to a modern language.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite in a modern cloud-native language: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, or Go.

findings.title: Tightly coupled monolith with no module boundaries
findings.description: Tightly coupled monolith. SQL queries embedded directly in presentation templates. Business logic, data access, and HTML rendering interleaved. Pervasive shared state.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with pervasive shared state, no module boundaries, no service separation.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, structure with clear separation of concerns. Consider if microservices decomposition is warranted for the application's scale.

findings.title: All communication synchronous with no async patterns
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. No async patterns detected. For a stateful-crud service, no asynchronous communication for state change propagation.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement asynchronous patterns for document upload processing and notifications using SQS or EventBridge.

findings.title: All operations synchronous regardless of duration
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No async job processing, no status polling, no background workers.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous. No async job infrastructure for potentially long-running document operations.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement async patterns with status polling for operations exceeding 30 seconds.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning. URLs are simple file-based routes (index.cfm, download.cfm). No version prefixes or headers.
findings.gap: No versioning — changes break all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement URL-path-based API versioning from day one.

findings.title: No service discovery — hardcoded datasource
findings.description: Single monolith with datasource 'docportal' configured in ColdFusion Administrator. No service registry, no API catalog.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in application configuration.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting and deploying on ECS/EKS, use AWS Cloud Map or environment-variable-based service discovery.

findings.title: Documents stored on local filesystem with no object storage
findings.description: Documents stored on local filesystem (D:\docroot\files) with no object storage, no backups offsite, no parsing pipeline.
findings.gap: Data on local file systems with no object storage, no accessibility, no backup.
findings.recommendation: Migrate document storage to Amazon S3 with SSE-KMS encryption, versioning, and lifecycle policies. Consider Textract for document parsing.

findings.title: Database queries scattered in presentation templates
findings.description: cfquery blocks with raw SQL (string concatenation) appear inline in both index.cfm and download.cfm. No repository pattern, no DAO, no ORM.
findings.gap: Database queries scattered across presentation files with no pattern. SQL injection vulnerable.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement a repository/DAO pattern with parameterized queries.

findings.title: SQL Server 2005 — EOL since April 2016
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 reached end-of-life April 2016. Over 9 years without security patches. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists).
findings.gap: Database engine at EOL with no version management. Known unpatched vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to a supported engine: RDS SQL Server 2019/2022 or Aurora PostgreSQL.

findings.title: No encryption at rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configured. Documents on local disk without encryption. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for file storage or database.
findings.recommendation: Migrate files to S3 with SSE-KMS. Migrate database to RDS with encryption enabled.

findings.title: No token-based authentication
findings.description: Session-based auth with fixation vulnerability. download.cfm has no auth check. No OAuth2, no JWT.
findings.gap: No token-based authentication. Session-based auth with fixation vulnerability. download.cfm unauthenticated.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2/JWT-based authentication with Cognito. Ensure all endpoints require authentication.

findings.title: No centralized identity provider
findings.description: Application manages authentication entirely with no external IdP. No SSO, no Cognito, no OIDC.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication with no external IdP integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or corporate IdP for SSO.

findings.title: Plaintext credentials in version control
findings.description: Plaintext credentials present in README. Password 'cfadmin' documented. Datasource credentials in CF Administrator with no secrets management.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in documentation. No secrets management system.
findings.recommendation: Store all credentials in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation. Remove plaintext credentials from documentation.

findings.title: No compute hardening or patching
findings.description: No patching strategy. Windows Server 2008 (EOL) and ColdFusion 8 (EOL, multiple critical CVEs) running unpatched.
findings.gap: No patching strategy. EOL OS and application runtime with known critical vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Decommission EOL stack. Redeploy on Fargate/Lambda or hardened AMIs with SSM Patch Manager.

findings.title: No security scanning in pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools. No CI/CD pipeline exists. Known SQL injection and path traversal vulnerabilities persist undetected.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools. No pipeline for security validation.
findings.recommendation: When implementing CI/CD, include SAST, dependency scanning, and container scanning with security gates.

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no observability instrumentation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. No ability to trace requests or diagnose production issues.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry from day one.

findings.title: No SLO definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No monitoring artifacts, no CloudWatch alarms, no latency or error rate tracking.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for document search latency, download availability, and error rate.

findings.title: No business metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business outcome tracking. No CloudWatch custom metrics or dashboards.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — no visibility into business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for documents downloaded, searches performed, active users.

findings.title: No anomaly detection or alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection, no incident management integration.
findings.gap: No alerting. Failures discovered only when users report them.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection. Integrate with PagerDuty/OpsGenie.

findings.title: No automated tests
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind. No unit tests, no integration tests, no end-to-end tests. No test frameworks.
findings.gap: No integration tests — no automated verification of system functionality.
findings.recommendation: When rewriting, implement integration tests from day one. Run tests in CI pipeline on every commit.

findings.title: No observability ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership defined. No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no named alarm owners. No observability infrastructure exists.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: When establishing observability, define clear ownership with per-service dashboards and named alarm owners.
